hints.title: Knight Distance Precomputation
hints.text: Run breadth-first search from each pawn location and starting knight coordinate on the 50x50 chessboard to compute pairwise knight move distances.

hints.title: Game State Representation
hints.text: Since the number of pawns p is at most 15, represent the subset of captured pawns as a bitmask.

hints.title: Minimax Dynamic Programming
hints.text: Define state (current_node, captured_mask, is_alice). Alice chooses the remaining pawn to maximize total moves, while Bob chooses the remaining pawn to minimize moves.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: BFS computes all pairwise distances in O(p * 2500). Minimax memoization explores p * 2^p states.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all move paths without precomputed shortest paths and bitmask memoization leads to infinite knight branching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitmask table of size 16 * 2^15 fits easily in memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combines BFS grid shortest paths with bitmask DP minimax game tree.
